summary: Kevin Lawrence, 52, mine owner/operator of Alma/Leadville, found dead deep inside the Ajax Mine (Buckskin Gulch, northwest of Alma) after a partial mine collapse; his brother found the body after ~a week without contact; recovery postponed due to mine instability; body recovered March 17 by multi-agency crews
location: Ajax Mine, Buckskin Gulch, northwest of Alma
responding_agency: Park County Sheriff's Office / Park County Coroner's Office, U.S. Mine Safety and Health Administration, Front Range Mine Rescue Team
notes: Index date = body discovery (Saturday 2012-03-10, weekday-verified; Flume: body found Saturday, recovery attempt Sunday; CCM: rescuers worked March 11). Age discrepancy: Flume says 52, Colorado Central Magazine says 51. Recovery completed 2012-03-17.
